it would be great if ggvis plots would be able to show more info if you hover over a (e.g.) point on a scatterplot. One example might be to display the group name and the (real) coordinates.

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: hover - What might be additionally displayed?
parts:
Here is a simple example. The idea is you can use any function that returns a HTML string to use as tooltip. Note that these plots requires Shiny (at least currently).

qvis(mtcars, ~wt, ~mpg) +
  tooltip(function(df){
    sprintf("<b>Weight</b>: %s
    <b>Mileage </b>: %s
    ", df$wt, df$mpg)
  })
